C0786.title: Surge in Malicious PyPI and npm Packages Targeting DevOps and CI/CD Environments
C0786.summary: Security researchers have identified a sharp increase in malicious PyPI and npm packages designed to steal developer credentials, CI/CD data, and cryptocurrency wallets. The campaigns target macOS systems, AI workflows, and cloud environment configurations, compromising open-source package registries to execute software supply chain attacks that pose a severe threat to DevOps pipelines relying on
